verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers a formation guide and the free Document Driver, which generates Delaware C-Corp/LLC formation documents. Its executive compensation practice advises on equity structures such as stock purchases and options. None of the cited material explicitly addresses founder vesting schedules, 83(b) elections, or co-founder equity splits; the Capital Calculator covers dilution from preferred financings, not day-zero founder allocation. Missing for 10: explicit founder vesting guidance, 83(b) election or local-equivalent coverage, co-founder equity split guidance or tooling, and independent corroboration.
